---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something NeuroScan doesn't do yet
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What problem does this solve

Describe the actual problem first, not just the feature. Sometimes there's a simpler fix for the underlying issue than the feature being proposed.

## What you're proposing

A clear description of the feature or change.

## What you considered and rejected

Any alternative approaches you thought about, and why you landed on this one instead.

## Anything else relevant

Links to similar implementations elsewhere, relevant papers, mockups, whatever helps make the case.
